title: Monthly cumulative transplant counts — create_cumulative_df
text: Adds month 0 row (value = 0) every yearly line starts zero. Ensures every month 0–12 present, forward-filling missing values output plot-ready. Trims future months beyond reporting cut-.

title: Extract donor data from PDF reports — extract_donor_data_from_pdfs
Extract donor data from PDF reports — extract_donor_data_from_pdfs
text: folder_path (character) Full relative path folder containing PDF files. function recursively search files ".pdf" extension (case-insensitive).

title: Extract donor data from PDF reports — extract_donor_data_from_pdfs
text: tibble containing extracted donor information following columns: donor_number - ODT donor identification number donor_dob - Date birth (character format) donor_age_year - Age years donor_sex - Gender (M/F) donor_height - Height centimeters donor_weight - Weight kilograms donor_hypertension - Hypertension status (Yes/) donor_diabetes - Diabetes status (Yes/) donor_cmv - CMV status (Positive/Negative) donor_hcv - HCV status donor_creatinine - Serum creatinine level (μmol/L) donor_egfr - Estimated glomerular filtration rate donor_date_admission - Hospital admission date donor_type - Donor type (DBD/DCD) donor_pr_dg - Primary diagnosis donor_cause_of_death - Cause death donor_adrenaline - Adrenaline usage status donor_noradrenaline - Noradrenaline usage status donor_kts - Date/time surgery commenced donor_treatment_withdrawal - Treatment withdrawal time (DCD donors) donor_perfusion_start - Systemic perfusion start time donor_perfusion_start_dcd - Cold -situ perfusion start time (DCD) donor_left_kidney_perfusion_quality - Quality perfusion left kidney donor_right_kidney_perfusion_quality - Quality perfusion right kidney donor_days_in_hospital - Calculated days admission surgery filename - Source PDF filename reference

title: Extract donor data from PDF reports — extract_donor_data_from_pdfs
text: function automatically: Scans PDF files specified directory Extracts text content PDF using pdftools package Applies regex patterns identify extract specific donor variables Calculates derived variables days hospital Handles errors gracefully informative warnings problematic files Returns clean tibble extracted donor information

title: Extract donor data from PDF reports — extract_donor_data_from_pdfs
text: Missing folder: Function stops informative error message PDF files: Returns empty tibble warning Corrupted PDFs: Individual file failures logged warnings, processing continues remaining files Date parsing errors: Days hospital calculation defaults NA date parsing fails

title: Extract donor data from PDF reports — extract_donor_data_from_pdfs
text: Requires pdftools, dplyr, stringr, tibble packages. Make sure loaded calling function.

title: Extract donor data from PDF reports — extract_donor_data_from_pdfs
text: Processing time scales linearly number size PDF files Large batches (>100 files) may take several minutes Progress messages printed console processing
